notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Sakashima the Impostor do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Sakashima the Impostor.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
